description: Figure 2 is a bar chart that compares the accuracy of different models on two tasks: paraphrase sentiment and STS (Semantic Textual Similarity). The horizontal axis displays the different models, which are listed as "BERT", "RoBERTa", "DeBERTa", "SimCSE", "2-Tier SimCSE", and "2-Tier SimCSE (Fine-tuned)". The vertical axis represents the accuracy score, with a scale from 0 to 100. The chart shows that the "2-Tier SimCSE (Fine-tuned)" model achieves the highest accuracy on both tasks, with scores of approximately 95% for paraphrase sentiment and 92% for STS. The "SimCSE" model has the second-highest accuracy, followed by "DeBERTa", "RoBERTa", and "BERT", with "BERT" having the lowest accuracy on both tasks. The bars are colored in a dark blue shade, and the chart includes a legend indicating that the bars represent the accuracy of the models on the two tasks.
